# Funnel 0.0.1

The first pre-release of **Funnel**, a self-hosted GitHub issue cockpit: a dense,
keyboard-friendly triage desk over the repositories you choose, with a public
intake queue in front of it and a GitHub App created during first-run
onboarding.

This is an early build. Expect breaking changes and rough edges while the
`0.0.x` line settles; do not treat it as production-ready.

## Downloads

| Platform | Asset |
| :--- | :--- |
| Linux x64 (glibc) | `funnel-0.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 (glibc) | `funnel-0.0.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Apple silicon | `funnel-0.0.1-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Intel | `funnel-0.0.1-darwin-x64.tar.gz` |
| Windows x64 | `funnel-0.0.1-windows-x64.zip` |

Each archive contains a single self-contained `funnel` executable. The Windows
archive also contains `funnel.exe`, the optional `funnel-intake.exe` hotkey
helper, and the PowerShell service and intake installers. Funnel embeds the Bun
runtime, the server, client assets, the native Markdown addon, and the committed
database migrations — no Bun, Node.js, or container runtime is required.

## Verify

```sh
# Linux and macOS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

```powershell
# Windows
Get-FileHash .\funnel-0.0.1-windows-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-Content .\SHA256SUMS.txt
```

## Run

### Linux and macOS

```sh
tar xzf funnel-0.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz
cd funnel-0.0.1-linux-x64
./funnel --version

# Funnel needs an encryption secret. Put it in .env beside the working directory:
openssl rand -base64 32   # -> FUNNEL_SECRET=...
./funnel
```

Open <http://localhost:3000/onboarding>. A fresh instance redirects every
user-facing route to the wizard until a GitHub App exists. The wizard creates
the App, installs it, lets you choose repositories, and then sends you to sign
in. The first account to sign in becomes `admin`.

### Windows

```powershell
Expand-Archive .\funnel-0.0.1-windows-x64.zip -DestinationPath .
cd .\funnel-0.0.1-windows-x64
.\funnel.exe --version
.\funnel.exe
```

Or install it as a Windows service from an elevated prompt. The installer
copies the executable to `C:\ProgramData\Funnel`, generates a starter `.env`
with a random `FUNNEL_SECRET`, and registers the WinSW service:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-service.ps1
```

The optional intake helper is per-user and needs no elevation:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-intake.ps1 -Url http://localhost:3000
```

## Notes

- Funnel is a **single instance**: it owns one SQLite database and an uploads
  directory. Do not scale it horizontally or run two instances against the same
  data directory.
- State lives in `./data` by default (`FUNNEL_DATA_DIR`, `FUNNEL_DB`, and
  `FUNNEL_UPLOAD_DIR` override it). The packaged executable applies pending
  migrations on boot; `./funnel --migrate` applies them without starting the
  server.
- Health probes: `/healthz` (liveness) and `/readyz` (readiness, which reports
  `503` until every committed migration is applied).
- The macOS and Windows binaries are unsigned. If macOS Gatekeeper quarantines
  the downloaded executable, remove the attribute with
  `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ./funnel`; Windows SmartScreen may warn on the
  unsigned `.exe`.
- Linux builds target glibc. Alpine/musl users should build from source.
